style.backgroundSystem: white tile wall #FFFFFF with a soft lake-blue wash #E8F3FA rising from the lower third, folded cotton cloth stacked in the mid-ground for depth
style.iconSystem: uniform thin-line lake-blue droplet outline icons, 2px stroke, no fill, circular badge frames
style.lightingSystem: bright even 5700K diffused studio light, front-top key with broad soft fill, low-contrast shadow edges, soft believable contact shadow anchoring the product, clean specular strips on plastic
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: bright clean laundry-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, lake blue #4FA3D1, deep lake blue #17557F for text, and lemon green #A8D33A accent; neutral 5700K bright even diffused lighting with soft believable contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; uniform thin-line lake-blue droplet outline icons; white tile wall #FFFFFF and folded cotton cloth background with a soft lake-blue wash #E8F3FA; realistic plastic pack rendering with true liquid viscosity and a thin film clinging to the inner wall; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no brand logo, watermark, QR code or membership badge
no price, discount, capacity, weight or size numbers
no ingredient percentages, active-matter content or cleaning-multiple claims
no certification, test report, standard number or origin claim
no fabricated before-after stain results, no magic self-cleaning fabric
no child using the product alone, no ingestion, no liquid near eyes or wounds
style.presentationRules: stable upright 3/4 hero with the base anchored on the surface, verticals plumb, product scale and placement identical across the set, label orientation always legible
style.surfaceSystem: matte white ceramic tile and light grey stone counter #DCE9F0, faint speckle, no gloss flare
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline #17557F, subtitle #4FA3D1, labels #17557F on white rounded cards
